description: This file prepares Bokeh plots for the CAA tab in a dashboard, including voltage and current plots for lamps and CAA components, and combines them into a tab layout.

methods.name: lamp_volt
methods.description: Creates a Bokeh plot for lamp voltages over time.

methods.name: lamp_current
methods.description: Creates a Bokeh plot for lamp currents over time.

methods.name: caa_volt
methods.description: Creates a Bokeh plot for CAA voltages over time.

methods.name: caa_plots
methods.description: Combines individual plots into a Bokeh tab layout for the CAA monitoring dashboard.
